parsed.report_to_operator: Please rule on TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' legality: it includes EVAL_SHARD=10. The rules make TRAIN_SHARDS an editable hyperparameter with evaluate_bpb fixed as ground truth, so half the team uses 0-10 while agents 5/7/8 showed the gains vanish on clean 0-9. A ruling is needed since it determines whether ~0.87 numbers are real.
